properties.description: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
Invalid limits take priority and leave alarms unchanged.
The hysteresis range must be smaller than the limit separation.
Valid input clears transient configuration errors.
A high excursion activates the high alarm.
Below the strict release boundary, high alarm clears.
The high hysteresis band retains history.
A low excursion activates the low alarm.
Above the strict low release boundary, low alarm clears.
The low hysteresis band retains history.

atomic_propositions.hiPrev: {"kind": "previous_observed_output", "source": "O[k-1].hiAlarm", "initial": false, "update": "After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].hiAlarm; never write into reference state."}
atomic_propositions.loPrev: {"kind": "previous_observed_output", "source": "O[k-1].loAlarm", "initial": false, "update": "After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].loAlarm; never write into reference state."}
atomic_propositions.interface names: Identically named sampled input or observed output.
atomic_propositions.hiAlarm: O[k].hiAlarm: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.loAlarm: O[k].loAlarm: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.error: O[k].error: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.status: O[k].status: independently observed post-scan candidate value (WORD); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.hiAlarm=false, O_init.loAlarm=false, O_init.error=false, O_init.status=0.
atomic_propositions.real32: IEEE754 binary32 rounding to nearest ties-to-even; finite declared domain. All REAL input symbols denote binary32 sampled values.
